classes.name: Setting
classes.description: Represents the model class for managing store settings in Opencart's admin module, providing CRUD operations.

methods.name: getSettings
methods.description: Retrieves all settings for a specific store ID, including default store settings.

methods.name: getSetting
methods.description: Fetches setting key-value pairs for a specific code and store ID, decoding serialized data when necessary.

methods.name: editSetting
methods.description: Updates or creates settings for a specific code and store ID, first deleting existing entries.

methods.name: deleteSetting
methods.description: Deletes all settings associated with a specific code and store ID.

methods.name: deleteSettingsByCode
methods.description: Deletes all settings with a specific code across all stores.

methods.name: deleteSettingsByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all settings associated with a specific store ID across all codes.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a setting for a specific key and store ID, decoding JSON if serialized.

methods.name: editValue
methods.description: Updates a specific setting key-value pair for a store, encoding JSON if necessary.
